name: Information security policies
description: Policies for information security management
control_objective: Establish management direction and support for information security

steps: Develop comprehensive information security policies
Obtain management approval for policies
Publish and communicate policies to all personnel
Establish policy review and update procedures
requirements: Policies must be approved by management
Policies must be published and accessible
Regular review procedures must be established

name: Information security roles and responsibilities
description: Allocation and communication of information security responsibilities
control_objective: Ensure clear allocation and communication of information security responsibilities

steps: Define information security roles and responsibilities
Update job descriptions to include security duties
Establish accountability mechanisms and reporting structures
requirements: All personnel must have documented security responsibilities
Job descriptions must include security duties

name: Segregation of duties
description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility segregated
control_objective: Reduce risk of accidental or deliberate misuse of organizational assets

steps: Identify conflicting duties and areas of responsibility
Separate conflicting duties between different individuals
Implement approval workflows for sensitive operations
Document segregation requirements
Monitor compliance with segregation controls
requirements: Conflicting duties must be separated
Approval workflows must be implemented
Segregation requirements must be documented

name: Management responsibilities
description: Management requirements to apply information security
control_objective: Ensure management actively supports information security through clear requirements

steps: Establish management requirements for information security
Define management oversight responsibilities
Create governance structures
Implement regular reporting mechanisms
requirements: Management requirements must be clearly defined
Governance structures must be established
Regular reporting must be implemented

name: Contact with authorities
description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities maintained
control_objective: Maintain appropriate contacts with relevant authorities for incident response

steps: Identify relevant authorities (law enforcement, regulators, emergency services)
Maintain current contact information
Establish communication procedures
Test contact mechanisms regularly
requirements: Contact information must be current and accessible
Communication procedures must be documented
Contact mechanisms must be tested regularly

name: Contact with special interest groups
description: Contacts with special interest groups maintained
control_objective: Maintain contacts with security forums and professional associations

steps: Identify relevant security professional groups and industry forums
Establish relationships with specialist security associations
Participate in information sharing initiatives
Join threat intelligence communities
requirements: Relationships must be formally established
Participation in information sharing must be documented

name: Threat intelligence
description: Information relating to information security threats collected and analyzed
control_objective: Collect and analyze information about information security threats

steps: Establish threat intelligence gathering processes
Subscribe to relevant threat feeds and security bulletins
Analyze threat information for organizational relevance
Update security measures based on threat analysis
requirements: Threat intelligence processes must be documented
Threat feeds must be regularly monitored
Analysis results must inform security updates

name: Information security in project management
description: Information security integrated into project management
control_objective: Ensure information security is addressed in project management

steps: Integrate security requirements into project management methodologies
Include security reviews at project milestones
Assign security responsibilities within project teams
Document security considerations in project plans
requirements: Security requirements must be included in all projects
Security reviews must be conducted at defined milestones
Security responsibilities must be clearly assigned

name: Inventory of information and other associated assets
description: Assets associated with information and information processing facilities identified
control_objective: Identify and maintain an inventory of information and associated assets

steps: Create comprehensive asset inventories
Include information assets, IT assets, and associated assets
Assign asset owners for each identified asset
Classify assets according to organizational importance
Maintain and regularly update asset inventories
requirements: All assets must be inventoried
Asset owners must be assigned
Asset classification must be documented
Inventories must be regularly updated

name: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
description: Rules for acceptable use of information and assets identified and documented
control_objective: Define and communicate acceptable use rules for information and assets

steps: Develop acceptable use policies for information systems
Cover networks and information assets in policies
Communicate policies to all users
Obtain user acknowledgment of policies
Monitor compliance with acceptable use policies
Enforce policies when violations occur
requirements: Policies must cover all information systems and assets
User acknowledgment must be documented
Compliance monitoring must be implemented
Policy enforcement procedures must be established

name: Return of assets
description: Personnel and other parties return all organizational assets in their possession
control_objective: Ensure all organizational assets are returned when employment or agreement ends

steps: Establish procedures for asset return upon termination
Maintain records of assets assigned to individuals
Verify return of all physical assets
Verify return of access credentials and digital assets
Document completion of asset return process
requirements: Asset return procedures must be documented
Asset assignment records must be maintained
Asset return must be verified and documented
All access credentials must be revoked

name: Classification of information
description: Information classified according to legal requirements and value to the organization
control_objective: Classify information according to its sensitivity and importance

steps: Develop information classification scheme based on legal requirements
Align classification with business value and sensitivity
Train personnel on classification procedures
Implement handling requirements for each classification level
Regularly review and update classification scheme
requirements: Classification scheme must be documented
Personnel must be trained on classification procedures
Handling requirements must be defined for each level

name: Labelling of information
description: Appropriate set of procedures for information labelling developed and implemented
control_objective: Implement appropriate labelling procedures for information

steps: Develop labelling procedures that align with information classification.
Implement both physical and electronic labelling systems.
requirements: Train users on labelling requirements and procedures.

name: Information transfer
description: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements in place for all types of transfer facilities
control_objective: Protect information during transfer within and outside the organization

steps: Establish secure information transfer procedures for all communication methods.
Implement encryption for sensitive data transfers.
Create agreements covering information transfer with external parties.
requirements: Information transfer procedures must be documented and approved
Encryption must be used for sensitive data transfers
Transfer agreements must be established with external parties

name: Access control
description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets established
control_objective: Control access to information and information processing facilities

steps: Develop access control policies covering both physical and logical access.
Implement role-based access controls.
Establish access review and approval procedures.
requirements: Access control policies must be documented and approved
Access controls must be implemented for both physical and logical access
Regular access reviews must be conducted

name: Identity management
description: Full life cycle of identities managed
control_objective: Manage the full lifecycle of user identities

steps: Implement identity management processes covering identity creation, modification, and deletion.
Establish identity verification procedures.
Maintain accurate identity records and regular reviews.
requirements: Identity management processes must cover the full lifecycle
Identity verification procedures must be established
Identity records must be maintained and regularly reviewed

name: Authentication information
description: Allocation and management of authentication information controlled by management process
control_objective: Control the allocation and management of authentication information

steps: Implement secure authentication information management including password policies, multi-factor authentication, and secure distribution of credentials.
Establish procedures for credential reset and recovery.
requirements: Authentication information management must be controlled by formal processes
Strong authentication mechanisms must be implemented
Credential distribution and recovery procedures must be secure

name: Access rights
description: Access rights to information and other associated assets provided, reviewed and modified
control_objective: Manage access rights throughout their lifecycle

steps: Implement access rights management processes including provisioning, regular review, and timely removal.
Establish approval workflows for access requests.
Conduct periodic access reviews.
requirements: Access rights must be managed throughout their lifecycle
Approval workflows must be established for access requests
Regular access reviews must be conducted

name: Information security in supplier relationships
description: Processes and procedures defined and implemented to manage information security risks
control_objective: Manage information security risks in supplier relationships

steps: Establish supplier security assessment procedures.
Implement ongoing monitoring of supplier security performance.
requirements: Define security requirements for supplier selection.

name: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
description: Relevant information security requirements established and agreed with each supplier
control_objective: Establish and agree information security requirements with suppliers

steps: Define security responsibilities and obligations.
requirements: Include comprehensive security requirements in supplier contracts.
Establish incident reporting and breach notification requirements.

name: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
description: Processes and procedures defined and implemented to manage information security risks
control_objective: Manage information security risks associated with ICT products and services supply chain

steps: Assess security risks in the ICT supply chain.
Monitor and manage supply chain security throughout the lifecycle.
requirements: Implement security requirements for ICT suppliers.

name: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
description: Organizations regularly monitor, review and evaluate supplier service delivery
control_objective: Monitor and review supplier service delivery and manage changes

steps: Establish supplier monitoring procedures including performance metrics and security indicators.
Conduct regular supplier reviews.
Implement change management procedures for supplier services.
requirements: Supplier monitoring procedures must include performance and security metrics
Regular supplier reviews must be conducted
Change management procedures must be implemented for supplier services

name: Information security for use of cloud services
description: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services established
control_objective: Manage information security for cloud service acquisition, use, management and exit

steps: Develop cloud security policies and procedures.
Assess cloud service providers for security capabilities.
Implement secure cloud configuration and data protection measures.
requirements: Cloud security policies and procedures must be developed
Cloud service providers must be assessed for security capabilities
Secure cloud configuration and data protection measures must be implemented

name: Information security incident management planning and preparation
description: Organization plans and prepares for managing information security incidents
control_objective: Plan and prepare for information security incident management

steps: Develop incident response plans and procedures.
Establish incident response team with defined roles and responsibilities.
Conduct regular incident response training and exercises.
requirements: Incident response plans and procedures must be developed
Incident response team must be established with defined roles
Regular incident response training and exercises must be conducted

name: Assessment and decision on information security events
description: Organization assesses information security events and decides if they are to be categorized as incidents
control_objective: Assess information security events and determine incident classification

steps: Establish event assessment procedures and criteria for incident classification.
Train personnel on event evaluation.
Implement decision-making processes for incident escalation.
requirements: Event assessment procedures and incident classification criteria must be established
Personnel must be trained on event evaluation
Decision-making processes for incident escalation must be implemented
